---
---

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Teste de Condicionamento de Marca</title>

<style>
  :root{
    --bg: #F4EEE2;
    --bg-2: #FFFFFF;
    --ink: #1B2340;
    --ink-soft: #5A5F72;
    --card: #FFFFFF;
    --card-border: rgba(27,35,64,0.08);
    --accent: #B3242A;
    --accent-ink: #FFFFFF;
    --good: #1E7A46;
    --bad: #B3242A;
    --chip-bg: #EFE7D6;
    --gold: #B8860B;
    --silver: #6B7280;
    --bronze: #A15C2E;
    --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(27,35,64,0.12);
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
      --bg: #14192B; --bg-2: #1C2340; --ink: #F2EFE6; --ink-soft: #B9BED0;
      --card: #1F2748; --card-border: rgba(242,239,230,0.10);
      --accent: #E2574C; --accent-ink: #14192B; --good: #4CC48A; --bad: #E2574C;
      --chip-bg: #262E52; --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg: #14192B; --bg-2: #1C2340; --ink: #F2EFE6; --ink-soft: #B9BED0;
    --card: #1F2748; --card-border: rgba(242,239,230,0.10);
    --accent: #E2574C; --accent-ink: #14192B; --good: #4CC48A; --bad: #E2574C;
    --chip-bg: #262E52; --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  }

  #brandquiz-root, #brandquiz-root *{ box-sizing: border-box; }
  #brandquiz-root{
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Calibri, Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg);
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    min-height: 100%; display:flex; justify-content:center;
  }
  html{ scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); }
  html, body{ height:100%; margin:0; background: var(--bg); }

  #brandquiz-root .app{
    width:100%; max-width: 480px; padding: 18px 16px 28px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-height:100vh;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .app.wide{ max-width: 720px; }

  #brandquiz-root header.top{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  #brandquiz-root .brandmark{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  #brandquiz-root .brandmark .dot{ width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%; background: var(--accent); }
  #brandquiz-root .progress-pill{
    font-size:12px; font-weight:700; background: var(--chip-bg); color: var(--ink);
    padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .progress-track{ height:6px; border-radius:999px; background: var(--chip-bg); overflow:hidden; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  #brandquiz-root .progress-fill{ height:100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius:999px; transition: width .35s ease; width:0%; }

  #brandquiz-root .screen{ display:none; flex:1; flex-direction:column; }
  #brandquiz-root .screen.active{ display:flex; }

  #brandquiz-root #screen-start{ justify-content:center; text-align:center; }
  #brandquiz-root #screen-start .eyebrow{
    font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root #screen-start h1{ font-size: 26px; line-height:1.25; margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif; }
  #brandquiz-root #screen-start p{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-size:15px; line-height:1.55; margin: 0 0 18px; }
  #brandquiz-root .preview-strip{ display:flex; gap:8px; justify-content:center; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  #brandquiz-root .preview-strip img{ width:44px; height:44px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); filter: saturate(1.05); }

  #brandquiz-root .field-label{ text-align:left; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:6px; }
  #brandquiz-root .name-input, #brandquiz-root input[type="password"], #brandquiz-root input[type="text"]{
    width:100%; font-family:inherit; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; padding: 13px 14px;
    border-radius: 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--card-border); background: var(--card); color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 14px; outline:none;
  }
  #brandquiz-root input:focus{ border-color: var(--accent); }

  #brandquiz-root .record-note{ margin-top:14px; font-size:13px; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  #brandquiz-root .btn{
    border:none; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:16px;
    padding: 15px 22px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  #brandquiz-root .btn:active{ transform: translateY(1px); }
  #brandquiz-root .btn.secondary{ background: var(--chip-bg); color: var(--ink); box-shadow:none; }
  #brandquiz-root .btn.danger{ background: var(--bad); }
  #brandquiz-root .btn.block{ width:100%; margin-bottom:10px; }
  #brandquiz-root .btn:disabled{ opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

  #brandquiz-root .text-link{
    background:none; border:none; text-decoration:underline; color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:12.5px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; padding: 6px; margin-top:4px;
  }

  #brandquiz-root .card{
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius: 20px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .photo-wrap{ position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background:#000; }
  #brandquiz-root .photo-wrap img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  #brandquiz-root .qmark-badge{
    position:absolute; top:12px; left:12px; background: rgba(20,25,43,0.72); color:#fff; font-weight:700;
    font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:6px 11px; border-radius:999px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .player-badge{
    position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; background: rgba(179,36,42,0.88); color:#fff; font-weight:700;
    font-size:11.5px; padding:6px 11px; border-radius:999px; max-width: 60%; overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap;
  }

  #brandquiz-root .question-text{ padding: 16px 16px 4px; font-size:15px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight:600; }
  #brandquiz-root .options{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:10px; padding: 12px 16px 18px; }
  #brandquiz-root .opt{
    border:1.5px solid var(--card-border); background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--ink); font-family:inherit;
    font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; padding: 13px 10px; border-radius: 12px; cursor:pointer; text-align:center;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .opt.correct{ background: var(--good); border-color: var(--good); color:#fff; }
  #brandquiz-root .opt.wrong{ background: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); color:#fff; }
  #brandquiz-root .opt.dim{ opacity:0.45; }
  #brandquiz-root .opt:disabled{ cursor:default; }

  #brandquiz-root .reveal{ padding: 2px 16px 18px; display:none; }
  #brandquiz-root .reveal.show{ display:block; }
  #brandquiz-root .reveal .result-line{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-weight:800; font-size:15px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  #brandquiz-root .reveal .result-line.ok{ color: var(--good); }
  #brandquiz-root .reveal .result-line.no{ color: var(--bad); }
  #brandquiz-root .reveal .insight{
    font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--chip-bg);
    border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 13px; margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .footer-actions{ margin-top:auto; }

  #brandquiz-root #screen-end{ text-align:center; }
  #brandquiz-root .score-ring{
    width:130px; height:130px; border-radius:50%; margin: 6px auto 14px; display:flex;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center; background: var(--chip-bg); border: 4px solid var(--accent);
    font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .score-ring .num{ font-size:34px; font-weight:800; line-height:1; }
  #brandquiz-root .score-ring .den{ font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); }
  #brandquiz-root #screen-end h2{ font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif; font-size:20px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
  #brandquiz-root #screen-end .player-line{ font-size:13.5px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:10px; }
  #brandquiz-root #screen-end p.msg{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; margin: 0 0 18px; }

  #brandquiz-root .section-label{
    text-align:left; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 6px 0 8px;
  }

  #brandquiz-root .recap-list{ text-align:left; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; margin-bottom:20px; }
  #brandquiz-root .recap-item{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background: var(--card); border:1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-radius:12px; padding:7px 10px; font-size:12.5px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .recap-item img{ width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0; }
  #brandquiz-root .recap-item .rname{ font-weight:800; flex:1; }
  #brandquiz-root .recap-item .rmark{ font-weight:800; font-size:15px; }
  #brandquiz-root .recap-item.hit .rmark{ color: var(--good); }
  #brandquiz-root .recap-item.miss .rmark{ color: var(--bad); }

  #brandquiz-root .ranking-list{ text-align:left; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; margin-bottom:18px; }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-item{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background: var(--card); border:1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-radius:12px; padding:9px 12px; font-size:13.5px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-item.me{ border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent) inset; }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-pos{
    width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center;
    justify-content:center; font-weight:800; font-size:12.5px; background: var(--chip-bg); color: var(--ink);
  }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-item.p1 .rank-pos{ background: var(--gold); color:#fff; }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-item.p2 .rank-pos{ background: var(--silver); color:#fff; }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-item.p3 .rank-pos{ background: var(--bronze); color:#fff; }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-name{ flex:1; font-weight:700; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-score{ font-weight:800; color: var(--accent); }
  #brandquiz-root .rank-empty{ font-size:13px; color: var(--ink-soft); text-align:center; padding: 10px 0 16px; }

  #brandquiz-root .recap-box{
    text-align:left; background: var(--chip-bg); border-radius:14px; padding:15px; font-size:13px;
    line-height:1.5; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .recap-box b{ color: var(--ink); }

  #brandquiz-root footer.credit{ text-align:center; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size:11.5px; margin-top: 18px; opacity:0.8; }

  /* ADMIN */
  #brandquiz-root .admin-entry{ text-align:center; margin-top:4px; }
  #brandquiz-root #screen-admin-login{ justify-content:center; }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-box{
    background: var(--card); border:1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius:18px;
    padding:22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-box h1{ font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif; font-size:21px; margin:0 0 4px; }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-box .sub{ font-size:12.5px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:18px; }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-error{ color: var(--bad); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; margin: -6px 0 12px; display:none; }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-error.show{ display:block; }

  #brandquiz-root .admin-header{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:6px; }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-header h1{ font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif; font-size:22px; margin:0; }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-status{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:12px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:18px; }
  #brandquiz-root .status-dot{ width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%; background: var(--ink-soft); flex-shrink:0; }
  #brandquiz-root .status-dot.live{ background: var(--good); }
  #brandquiz-root .status-dot.off{ background: var(--bad); }
  #brandquiz-root .admin-warning{
    background: var(--chip-bg); border-left:3px solid var(--accent); border-radius:8px;
    padding:10px 12px; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:18px; line-height:1.5;
  }

  #brandquiz-root .live-row{
    background: var(--card); border:1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius:14px;
    padding:11px 13px; margin-bottom:9px;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .live-row .lr-top{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:6px; gap:8px; }
  #brandquiz-root .live-row .lr-name{ font-weight:800; font-size:14.5px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
  #brandquiz-root .live-row .lr-meta{ font-size:11.5px; color: var(--ink-soft); white-space:nowrap; }
  #brandquiz-root .lr-progress{ font-size:12px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:7px; }
  #brandquiz-root .lr-progress b{ color: var(--ink); }
  #brandquiz-root .answer-dots{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:5px; }
  #brandquiz-root .answer-dot{
    width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:7px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#fff; flex-shrink:0;
  }
  #brandquiz-root .answer-dot.y{ background: var(--good); }
  #brandquiz-root .answer-dot.n{ background: var(--bad); }
  #brandquiz-root .answer-dot.pending{ background: var(--card-border); }

  #brandquiz-root .empty-note{ font-size:13px; color: var(--ink-soft); padding: 14px 0 8px; text-align:center; }

</style>

<div id="brandquiz-root">
<div class="app" id="appShell">

  <header class="top">
    <div class="brandmark"><span class="dot"></span>Condicionamento de Marca</div>
    <div class="progress-pill" id="progressPill">0 / 8</div>
  </header>
  <div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" id="progressFill"></div></div>

  <!-- START -->
  <section class="screen active" id="screen-start">
    <div class="eyebrow">Atividade prática</div>
    <h1>Você reconhece a marca<br>sem ver o nome ou o logo?</h1>
    <p>Oito imagens. Nenhum logotipo, nenhum nome escrito — só cor, forma e textura.
    Escolha a marca que seu cérebro reconhece primeiro e entre no ranking da turma.</p>
    <div class="preview-strip" id="previewStrip"></div>

    <div class="field-label">Seu nome (para o ranking)</div>
    <input class="name-input" id="playerNameInput" type="text" maxlength="24" placeholder="Digite seu nome" autocomplete="off">

    <button class="btn block" id="btnStart" disabled>Começar teste</button>
    <div class="record-note" id="recordNote"></div>
    <div class="admin-entry"><button class="text-link" id="btnAdminOpen">Painel do professor</button></div>
  </section>

  <!-- QUIZ -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-quiz">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="photo-wrap">
        <img id="quizImg" src="" alt="Estímulo visual da marca">
        <div class="qmark-badge">Sem logo · Sem nome</div>
        <div class="player-badge" id="playerBadge"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="question-text">Que marca é essa?</div>
      <div class="options" id="optionsGrid"></div>
      <div class="reveal" id="revealBox">
        <div class="result-line" id="resultLine"></div>
        <div class="insight" id="insightText"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="footer-actions">
      <button class="btn block" id="btnNext" disabled>Confirme uma opção acima</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- END -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-end">
    <div class="score-ring">
      <div><div class="num" id="finalScore">0</div><div class="den">de 8</div></div>
    </div>
    <h2 id="finalTitle">Resultado</h2>
    <div class="player-line" id="playerLine"></div>
    <p class="msg" id="finalMsg"></p>

    <div class="section-label">Como você se saiu</div>
    <div class="recap-list" id="recapList"></div>

    <div class="section-label">Ranking da turma</div>
    <div class="ranking-list" id="rankingList"></div>

    <div class="recap-box">
      <b>Por que isso funciona?</b> Cor, formato e embalagem repetidos de forma consistente
      viram <b>estímulos condicionados</b>: o cérebro aprende a associá-los à marca
      até dispensar o nome e o logotipo — o mesmo princípio de associação estímulo–resposta
      descrito por Pavlov, agora aplicado ao branding.
    </div>

    <button class="btn block" id="btnRestart">Jogar novamente</button>
  </section>

  <!-- ADMIN LOGIN -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-admin-login">
    <div class="admin-box">
      <h1>Painel do professor</h1>
      <div class="sub">Acompanhamento em tempo real das respostas e do ranking da turma.</div>
      <div class="field-label">Usuário</div>
      <input type="text" id="adminUser" autocomplete="off">
      <div class="field-label">Senha</div>
      <input type="password" id="adminPass" autocomplete="off">
      <div class="admin-error" id="adminError">Usuário ou senha incorretos.</div>
      <button class="btn block" id="btnAdminLogin">Entrar</button>
      <button class="text-link" id="btnAdminCancel">Voltar</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ADMIN DASHBOARD -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-admin">
    <div class="admin-header">
      <h1>Painel do professor</h1>
      <button class="text-link" id="btnAdminLogout">Sair</button>
    </div>
    <div class="admin-status">
      <span class="status-dot" id="adminStatusDot"></span>
      <span id="adminStatusText">Verificando conexão…</span>
    </div>
    <div class="admin-warning" id="adminWarning" style="display:none;"></div>

    <div class="section-label">Ao vivo — respondendo agora</div>
    <div id="liveList"></div>

    <div class="section-label">Ranking geral da turma</div>
    <div id="adminRankingList"></div>

    <button class="btn danger block" id="btnClearAll" style="margin-top:10px;">Limpar dados desta turma</button>
  </section>

  <footer class="credit">André Guilherme Louzada Azevedo · Psicólogo</footer>
</div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/firebase/12.3.0/firebase-app-compat.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/firebase/12.3.0/firebase-firestore-compat.min.js"></script>

<script>
(function(){
  const BRANDS = [{"id": "cocacola", "name": "Coca-Cola", "color": "#E30E17", "insight": "O vermelho e a curva branca em movimento foram repetidos por mais de um século — hoje o cérebro reconhece a marca antes mesmo de procurar o nome escrito.", "img": ""}, {"id": "nubank", "name": "Nubank", "color": "#8A05BE", "insight": "No Brasil, a cor roxa sozinha já virou sinônimo do banco: a repetição constante transformou uma cor neutra em estímulo condicionado de marca.", "img": ""}, {"id": "heinz", "name": "Heinz", "color": "#E4002B", "insight": "Mesmo com o rótulo em branco, o formato hexagonal da garrafa já é reconhecível — o design da embalagem funciona como estímulo condicionado.", "img": ""}, {"id": "adidas", "name": "Adidas", "color": "#0033A0", "insight": "Três listras diagonais bastam. Nenhuma letra do nome apareceu, e mesmo assim a resposta de reconhecimento veio automaticamente.", "img": ""}, {"id": "apple", "name": "Apple", "color": "#555555", "insight": "O recorte da câmera frontal (o \"notch\") já denuncia a marca antes mesmo da tela ligar — um detalhe de design virou sinal de reconhecimento instantâneo.", "img": ""}, {"id": "mcdonalds", "name": "McDonald's", "color": "#DA291C", "insight": "As batatas fritas, dispostas lado a lado, desenham sozinhas o contorno do arco dourado — a marca aparece mesmo sem aparecer.", "img": ""}, {"id": "bmw", "name": "BMW", "color": "#0066B1", "insight": "A grade dupla em forma de rim é copiada, comentada e reconhecida em fração de segundo — décadas de repetição visual consistente.", "img": ""}, {"id": "kfc", "name": "KFC", "color": "#C8102E", "insight": "As listras vermelhas e brancas do balde bastam — nem precisou aparecer o Coronel para o cérebro completar a associação.", "img": ""}];

  // =========================================================
  // FIREBASE — edite os valores abaixo com os dados do SEU
  // projeto Firebase (gratuito) para habilitar o acompanhamento
  // em tempo real entre dispositivos diferentes. Sem isso, o
  // teste funciona normalmente, mas o ranking fica só neste
  // aparelho e o painel do professor não recebe dados ao vivo.
  // Veja o passo a passo enviado junto com este arquivo.
  // =========================================================
  const FIREBASE_CONFIG = {
    apiKey: "COLE_AQUI_SUA_API_KEY",
    authDomain: "SEU-PROJETO.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "SEU-PROJETO",
    storageBucket: "SEU-PROJETO.appspot.com",
    messagingSenderId: "000000000000",
    appId: "1:000000000000:web:xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  };

  const ADMIN_USER = "andre.azevedo";
  const ADMIN_PASS = "psico2026!";

  let db = null;
  let fbEnabled = false;
  try{
    if(FIREBASE_CONFIG.apiKey && FIREBASE_CONFIG.apiKey.indexOf("COLE_AQUI") === -1 && window.firebase){
      firebase.initializeApp(FIREBASE_CONFIG);
      db = firebase.firestore();
      fbEnabled = true;
    }
  }catch(e){ console.warn("Firebase não inicializado:", e); fbEnabled = false; }

  const RANKING_KEY = 'brandquiz_ranking_v1';
  const LAST_NAME_KEY = 'brandquiz_last_name';
  const SESSIONS_COL = 'sessions';

  const state = { order: [], idx: 0, score: 0, answered: false, results: [], player: '', sessionId: null };

  function shuffle(arr){
    const a = arr.slice();
    for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]; }
    return a;
  }
  function imgSrc(b){ return "data:image/jpeg;base64," + b.img; }

  function buildPreview(){
    const strip = document.getElementById('previewStrip');
    shuffle(BRANDS).slice(0,5).forEach(b=>{
      const im = document.createElement('img'); im.src = imgSrc(b); strip.appendChild(im);
    });
  }

  function safeGet(key){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(key); }catch(e){ return null; } }
  function safeSet(key, val){ try{ localStorage.setItem(key, val); return true; }catch(e){ return false; } }

  // ---------- local (fallback) ranking ----------
  function getLocalRanking(){
    try{ const raw = safeGet(RANKING_KEY); const list = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; return Array.isArray(list) ? list : []; }
    catch(e){ return []; }
  }
  function saveLocalRanking(list){ safeSet(RANKING_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); }
  function addLocalResult(name, score, total){
    const list = getLocalRanking();
    const entry = { name: name, score: score, total: total, ts: Date.now() };
    list.push(entry);
    list.sort((a,b)=> b.score - a.score || a.ts - b.ts);
    saveLocalRanking(list.slice(0, 100));
    return entry;
  }

  function showScreen(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('#brandquiz-root .screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('appShell').classList.toggle('wide', id === 'screen-admin');
  }

  function updateProgress(){
    const total = state.order.length || 8;
    const cur = Math.min(state.idx + (state.answered?1:0), total);
    document.getElementById('progressPill').textContent = cur + ' / ' + total;
    document.getElementById('progressFill').style.width = ((cur/total)*100) + '%';
  }

  // ---------- QUIZ FLOW ----------
  function startQuiz(){
    const raw = document.getElementById('playerNameInput').value.trim().slice(0,24);
    state.player = raw || 'Aluno(a)';
    safeSet(LAST_NAME_KEY, state.player);

    state.order = shuffle(BRANDS);
    state.idx = 0;
    state.score = 0;
    state.results = [];
    state.sessionId = 't' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8);

    if(fbEnabled){
      db.collection(SESSIONS_COL).doc(state.sessionId).set({
        name: state.player, total: state.order.length, score: 0,
        answers: [], completed: false,
        startedAt: Date.now(), updatedAt: Date.now()
      }).catch(e=> console.warn('Firestore set falhou:', e));
    }

    showScreen('screen-quiz');
    renderQuestion();
  }

  function renderQuestion(){
    state.answered = false;
    const b = state.order[state.idx];
    document.getElementById('quizImg').src = imgSrc(b);
    document.getElementById('playerBadge').textContent = state.player;
    updateProgress();

    const pool = BRANDS.filter(x=>x.id!==b.id);
    const distractors = shuffle(pool).slice(0,3);
    const options = shuffle([b, ...distractors]);

    const grid = document.getElementById('optionsGrid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    options.forEach(opt=>{
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'opt'; btn.textContent = opt.name;
      btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>selectOption(btn, opt, b));
      grid.appendChild(btn);
    });

    document.getElementById('revealBox').classList.remove('show');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('btnNext');
    nextBtn.disabled = true;
    nextBtn.textContent = 'Confirme uma opção acima';
  }

  function selectOption(btn, chosen, correct){
    if(state.answered) return;
    state.answered = true;
    const isCorrect = chosen.id === correct.id;
    if(isCorrect) state.score++;
    state.results.push({ brand: correct, chosenName: chosen.name, hit: isCorrect });

    document.querySelectorAll('#brandquiz-root .opt').forEach(o=>{
      o.disabled = true;
      if(o.textContent === correct.name){ o.classList.add('correct'); }
      else if(o === btn){ o.classList.add('wrong'); }
      else { o.classList.add('dim'); }
    });

    const line = document.getElementById('resultLine');
    line.className = 'result-line ' + (isCorrect ? 'ok' : 'no');
    line.textContent = (isCorrect ? '✓ Isso mesmo — é ' : '✗ Era ') + correct.name + '.';
    document.getElementById('insightText').textContent = correct.insight;
    document.getElementById('revealBox').classList.add('show');

    updateProgress();

    if(fbEnabled && state.sessionId){
      const answersOut = state.results.map(r=>({ brandId: r.brand.id, brandName: r.brand.name, chosenName: r.chosenName, correct: r.hit }));
      db.collection(SESSIONS_COL).doc(state.sessionId).update({
        score: state.score, answers: answersOut, updatedAt: Date.now()
      }).catch(e=> console.warn('Firestore update falhou:', e));
    }

    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('btnNext');
    nextBtn.disabled = false;
    nextBtn.textContent = (state.idx === state.order.length-1) ? 'Ver resultado final' : 'Próxima marca';
  }

  function nextQuestion(){
    if(state.idx < state.order.length-1){ state.idx++; renderQuestion(); }
    else { finishQuiz(); }
  }

  function finishQuiz(){
    const total = state.order.length;

    if(fbEnabled && state.sessionId){
      const answersOut = state.results.map(r=>({ brandId: r.brand.id, brandName: r.brand.name, chosenName: r.chosenName, correct: r.hit }));
      db.collection(SESSIONS_COL).doc(state.sessionId).update({
        score: state.score, answers: answersOut, completed: true, updatedAt: Date.now(), finishedAt: Date.now()
      }).catch(e=> console.warn('Firestore update falhou:', e));
    }
    const localEntry = addLocalResult(state.player, state.score, total);

    document.getElementById('finalScore').textContent = state.score;
    document.getElementById('playerLine').textContent = state.player;

    let title, msg;
    const pct = state.score/total;
    if(pct === 1){ title = 'Reconhecimento total'; msg = 'Você identificou todas as marcas só pela cor e pela forma. É exatamente o efeito que o marketing busca criar por repetição.'; }
    else if(pct >= 0.75){ title = 'Muito condicionado(a)'; msg = 'Quase perfeito — sinal de quanto essas marcas repetem seus estímulos visuais no dia a dia.'; }
    else if(pct >= 0.5){ title = 'Condicionamento parcial'; msg = 'Metade ou mais das marcas já viraram estímulo automático para você. As outras ainda dependem do nome ou do logo.'; }
    else{ title = 'Pouco condicionado(a)'; msg = 'Você precisou de mais pistas do que a maioria — o que também mostra que nem toda marca consegue criar esse reflexo.'; }
    document.getElementById('finalTitle').textContent = title;
    document.getElementById('finalMsg').textContent = msg;

    const list = document.getElementById('recapList');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    state.results.forEach(r=>{
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'recap-item ' + (r.hit ? 'hit':'miss');
      const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = imgSrc(r.brand);
      const nm = document.createElement('div'); nm.className = 'rname'; nm.textContent = r.brand.name;
      const mk = document.createElement('div'); mk.className = 'rmark'; mk.textContent = r.hit ? '✓' : '✗';
      row.appendChild(img); row.appendChild(nm); row.appendChild(mk);
      list.appendChild(row);
    });

    if(fbEnabled){
      db.collection(SESSIONS_COL).where('completed','==',true).get().then(snap=>{
        const arr = [];
        snap.forEach(doc=> arr.push(doc.data()));
        arr.sort((a,b)=> b.score - a.score || (a.finishedAt||0) - (b.finishedAt||0));
        renderRankingRows(document.getElementById('rankingList'), arr.slice(0,10), state.player, state.sessionId);
      }).catch(e=>{
        console.warn('Firestore ranking falhou, usando local:', e);
        renderRankingRows(document.getElementById('rankingList'), getLocalRanking().slice(0,10), state.player, null, localEntry);
      });
    } else {
      renderRankingRows(document.getElementById('rankingList'), getLocalRanking().slice(0,10), state.player, null, localEntry);
    }

    showScreen('screen-end');
  }

  function renderRankingRows(container, list, myName, mySessionId, myLocalEntry){
    container.innerHTML = '';
    if(!list.length){
      const p = document.createElement('div'); p.className = 'rank-empty';
      p.textContent = 'Ainda não há resultados registrados nesta turma.';
      container.appendChild(p); return;
    }
    list.forEach((r, i)=>{
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      const pos = i+1;
      const isMe = myLocalEntry ? (r.ts === myLocalEntry.ts && r.name === myLocalEntry.name)
                                 : (myName && r.name === myName);
      row.className = 'rank-item' + (pos<=3 ? ' p'+pos : '') + (isMe ? ' me' : '');
      const posEl = document.createElement('div'); posEl.className = 'rank-pos'; posEl.textContent = String(pos);
      const nameEl = document.createElement('div'); nameEl.className = 'rank-name'; nameEl.textContent = r.name;
      const scoreEl = document.createElement('div'); scoreEl.className = 'rank-score'; scoreEl.textContent = r.score + '/' + (r.total || 8);
      row.appendChild(posEl); row.appendChild(nameEl); row.appendChild(scoreEl);
      container.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function goToStart(){
    showScreen('screen-start');
    const lastName = safeGet(LAST_NAME_KEY);
    const input = document.getElementById('playerNameInput');
    if(lastName){ input.value = lastName; }
    input.focus(); input.select();
    validateStart();
  }

  function validateStart(){
    const v = document.getElementById('playerNameInput').value.trim();
    document.getElementById('btnStart').disabled = v.length === 0;
  }

  document.getElementById('playerNameInput').addEventListener('input', validateStart);
  document.getElementById('playerNameInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if(e.key === 'Enter' && !document.getElementById('btnStart').disabled) startQuiz();
  });
  document.getElementById('btnStart').addEventListener('click', startQuiz);
  document.getElementById('btnNext').addEventListener('click', nextQuestion);
  document.getElementById('btnRestart').addEventListener('click', goToStart);

  buildPreview();
  const lastNameInit = safeGet(LAST_NAME_KEY);
  if(lastNameInit){ document.getElementById('playerNameInput').value = lastNameInit; }
  if(!fbEnabled){
    const rk = getLocalRanking();
    if(rk.length){ document.getElementById('recordNote').textContent = 'Líder atual (neste aparelho): ' + rk[0].name + ' — ' + rk[0].score + '/' + rk[0].total; }
  }
  validateStart();
  updateProgress();

  // =========================================================
  // ADMIN
  // =========================================================
  let adminUnsub = null;
  let adminRefreshTimer = null;
  let lastDocs = [];

  function timeAgo(ms){
    const s = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - ms)/1000));
    if(s < 60) return 'há ' + s + 's';
    const m = Math.round(s/60);
    if(m < 60) return 'há ' + m + 'min';
    const h = Math.round(m/60);
    return 'há ' + h + 'h';
  }

  function openAdminLogin(){
    document.getElementById('adminUser').value = '';
    document.getElementById('adminPass').value = '';
    document.getElementById('adminError').classList.remove('show');
    showScreen('screen-admin-login');
  }

  function tryAdminLogin(){
    const u = document.getElementById('adminUser').value.trim();
    const p = document.getElementById('adminPass').value;
    if(u === ADMIN_USER && p === ADMIN_PASS){
      openAdminDashboard();
    } else {
      document.getElementById('adminError').classList.add('show');
    }
  }

  function openAdminDashboard(){
    showScreen('screen-admin');
    const dot = document.getElementById('adminStatusDot');
    const txt = document.getElementById('adminStatusText');
    const warn = document.getElementById('adminWarning');

    if(!fbEnabled){
      dot.className = 'status-dot off';
      txt.textContent = 'Firebase não configurado';
      warn.style.display = 'block';
      warn.textContent = 'Este painel só acompanha respostas em tempo real quando o Firebase está configurado no arquivo (veja o passo a passo enviado junto). Sem isso, cada aparelho guarda seu próprio ranking, isolado.';
      renderAdminEmpty();
      return;
    }

    dot.className = 'status-dot live';
    txt.textContent = 'Conectado em tempo real';
    warn.style.display = 'none';

    if(adminUnsub){ adminUnsub(); adminUnsub = null; }
    adminUnsub = db.collection(SESSIONS_COL).orderBy('updatedAt','desc').limit(200)
      .onSnapshot(snap=>{
        lastDocs = [];
        snap.forEach(doc=> lastDocs.push(doc.data()));
        renderAdmin();
      }, err=>{
        console.warn('Snapshot falhou:', err);
        dot.className = 'status-dot off';
        txt.textContent = 'Erro de conexão com o Firebase';
        warn.style.display = 'block';
        warn.textContent = 'Não foi possível conectar ao Firestore. Confira se a configuração e as regras de segurança do seu projeto Firebase permitem leitura da coleção "sessions".';
      });

    if(adminRefreshTimer) clearInterval(adminRefreshTimer);
    adminRefreshTimer = setInterval(renderAdmin, 5000);
  }

  function renderAdminEmpty(){
    document.getElementById('liveList').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Sem dados — configure o Firebase para ver respostas ao vivo.</div>';
    document.getElementById('adminRankingList').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Sem dados — configure o Firebase para ver o ranking da turma.</div>';
  }

  function answerDotsHtml(answers, total){
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'answer-dots';
    for(let i=0;i<total;i++){
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      const a = answers[i];
      if(a){ d.className = 'answer-dot ' + (a.correct ? 'y' : 'n'); d.textContent = a.correct ? '✓' : '✗'; }
      else { d.className = 'answer-dot pending'; d.textContent = ''; }
      wrap.appendChild(d);
    }
    return wrap;
  }

  function renderAdmin(){
    const liveBox = document.getElementById('liveList');
    const rankBox = document.getElementById('adminRankingList');

    const live = lastDocs.filter(d=> !d.completed && (Date.now() - (d.updatedAt||0)) < 15*60*1000);
    const finished = lastDocs.filter(d=> d.completed);
    finished.sort((a,b)=> b.score - a.score || (a.finishedAt||0) - (b.finishedAt||0));

    liveBox.innerHTML = '';
    if(!live.length){
      liveBox.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Ninguém respondendo no momento.</div>';
    } else {
      live.forEach(d=>{
        const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'live-row';
        const top = document.createElement('div'); top.className = 'lr-top';
        const nm = document.createElement('div'); nm.className = 'lr-name'; nm.textContent = d.name;
        const meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className = 'lr-meta'; meta.textContent = timeAgo(d.updatedAt||0);
        top.appendChild(nm); top.appendChild(meta);
        const prog = document.createElement('div'); prog.className = 'lr-progress';
        prog.appendChild(document.createTextNode((d.answers||[]).length + ' / ' + d.total + ' respondidas · '));
        const b = document.createElement('b'); b.textContent = d.score + ' corretas';
        prog.appendChild(b);
        row.appendChild(top); row.appendChild(prog);
        row.appendChild(answerDotsHtml(d.answers||[], d.total||8));
        liveBox.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    rankBox.innerHTML = '';
    if(!finished.length){
      rankBox.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Ainda não há alunos com o teste concluído.</div>';
    } else {
      finished.slice(0,20).forEach((d,i)=>{
        const pos = i+1;
        const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'live-row';
        const top = document.createElement('div'); top.className = 'lr-top';
        const nm = document.createElement('div'); nm.className = 'lr-name';
        nm.textContent = pos + '. ' + d.name;
        const meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className = 'lr-meta'; meta.textContent = d.score + '/' + d.total;
        top.appendChild(nm); top.appendChild(meta);
        row.appendChild(top);
        row.appendChild(answerDotsHtml(d.answers||[], d.total||8));
        rankBox.appendChild(row);
      });
    }
  }

  function closeAdmin(){
    if(adminUnsub){ adminUnsub(); adminUnsub = null; }
    if(adminRefreshTimer){ clearInterval(adminRefreshTimer); adminRefreshTimer = null; }
    goToStart();
  }

  function clearAllData(){
    if(!confirm('Apagar TODOS os dados desta turma (respostas e ranking)? Essa ação não pode ser desfeita.')) return;
    if(fbEnabled){
      db.collection(SESSIONS_COL).get().then(snap=>{
        const batch = db.batch();
        snap.forEach(doc=> batch.delete(doc.ref));
        return batch.commit();
      }).then(()=>{
        saveLocalRanking([]);
        alert('Dados da turma apagados.');
      }).catch(e=>{
        console.warn(e);
        alert('Não foi possível apagar os dados no Firebase. Confira sua conexão e as regras do Firestore.');
      });
    } else {
      saveLocalRanking([]);
      alert('Ranking local apagado.');
      renderAdminEmpty();
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('btnAdminOpen').addEventListener('click', openAdminLogin);
  document.getElementById('btnAdminCancel').addEventListener('click', goToStart);
  document.getElementById('btnAdminLogin').addEventListener('click', tryAdminLogin);
  document.getElementById('adminPass').addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key === 'Enter') tryAdminLogin(); });
  document.getElementById('btnAdminLogout').addEventListener('click', closeAdmin);
  document.getElementById('btnClearAll').addEventListener('click', clearAllData);

})();
</script>
